The Dyson Sphere (QQQ) closed the session with a result of (-0,30%) and a demand test (CVD: 418,35 K).

  • Broad market: The Background Radiation (TICKQ) is at an extremely low level of -99,00 (with a SMA200 average of 117,83), signaling strong, extreme selling dominance in the Nasdaq broad market after the regular session ended.
